requirements.rationale: A person signed in to the hub needs to see who the hub thinks they are, correct their display name, and see which organizations they belong to.

criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with a JSON object holding exactly the members id, username, email, full_name, role, status, provider, provider_id, created_at, updated_at; id is the caller's user id; created_at and updated_at are RFC 3339 UTC with whole seconds

requirements.title: The admin check and selectors
requirements.rationale: Identity administration is for the operator and the users the operator promoted, and an operator names a person by whatever they have at hand: an id, an e-mail or a username.

criteria.condition: the caller of an admin route (POST /users, GET /users, GET|PATCH|DELETE /users/:id, POST /users/:id/promote|demote|block|unblock, POST /orgs, GET /orgs, PATCH|DELETE /orgs/:id, POST /orgs/:id/block|unblock, PUT|DELETE /orgs/:id/members/:user_id, all under /api/v1) is neither the admin token nor an API key whose user has role admin
criteria.action: refuse the request before validating its body and before looking up the user or org it names, changing nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type forbidden, the same for an existing target, a missing target and an invalid body; the store holds the same users, orgs and memberships as before

requirements.title: Creating a user with a personal organization
requirements.rationale: An operator must be able to add a person before that person ever signs in, and every user needs an org of their own so that there is always somewhere to put their workspaces.

criteria.condition: an admin sends POST /api/v1/users with non-empty strings username, email, provider and provider_id and an optional string full_name

criteria.contract: HTTP 201 with the User object (role user, status active, full_name as sent or the empty string, a new UUID as id); the store holds an org with the derived slug, name == username, owner_id == the user's id and status active, and exactly one membership of that org, the user's
